We attended the restoration ceremony for the Estill Federal Correctional Institution after a tornado destroyed the facility in 2020.

After six years, they are able to reopen better than ever. A huge accomplishment after securing a budget with money allocated from President Trump’s Big Beautiful Bill. This is the importance of the work in Washington to benefit the Lowcountry.

South Carolina STRONG.
They’re coming after me because I am standing up for YOU. 🇺🇸🇺🇸🇺🇸

The last few days have been hard. But the outpouring from so many of you has carried our family through it. If you have a "General Mace" story, please post it below. 

Mom likes to read the comments, some times every single one. (Yes, even after I've asked her not to.) 

Let's give her something worth reading. 🩷

ICYMI: This is the moment we made our motion to subpoena the sexual harassment slush fund.

We have been leading this charge from the start. We took action to force the release of the names of every Member of Congress who abused their public office and used your money to cover it up.

The American people deserve to know exactly who used their tax dollars to keep their secrets hidden.

Video

They’re coming after me because I am standing up for YOU and your values. 

Cory Mills allegedly beats women, has a restraining order against him from threatening a woman, reports say he’s an arms dealer while sitting on House Armed Services and Foreign Affairs, and rumored to be profiting off federal contracts from his own seat. He is neck-deep in fraud and police reports. He has no place in Congress. His rightful place is behind bars.

Because I will not back down from exposing him, he is tryi
Congress has serious moral and ethical problems, and McCormick, Gonzales, Mills, and Swalwell are the face of it.

We just introduced a resolution to EXPEL Cory Mills from the U.S. House of Representatives. 

The swamp has protected Cory Mills for far too long and we are done letting it slide. We tried to censure him and strip him from his committee assignments. Both parties blocked it, but we are not backing down. 

The evidence against Mills is overwhelming: beating women and telling them to lie about it, cyberstalking women, lying about his military service, and profiting off his seat. Any Member who vote

Why is there a letter from Cory Mills saying he worked for CCP-backed energy companies in China?

Video
We won't back down until the outcome column next to Cory Mills' name reads one word: Expelled.

LOWCOUNTRY UPDATE
Weekly Report from Congresswoman Nancy Mace

CONSTITUENT SERVICES
Our casework team is managing 577 active cases and has now returned $39,459,360 directly to constituents, money owed to them by the federal government. This marks a $53,000 increase from last week alone.
Every dollar returned is a dollar Washington tried to keep from a South Carolinian who earned it.

IN THE DISTRICT
Our team completed 15 events, meetings, ribbon cuttings, and site visits across the district this

Thank you @RepMichaelGuest Chairman of the House Ethics Committee, for this level of transparency today.

Now more than ever the predators among our ranks need to be exposed and expelled from Congress.


New York Post (@nypost)

How many Russian hookers has Cory Mills ever hired?

And why won’t the press share the image(s) of them? Why is the press protecting Cory Mills?

Sexual predators attack the women who expose them.

That’s a fact.

Shocker: two of the loudest voices viciously attacking me appear on the congressional list of “alleged sexual misconduct.”

I wish I could say I was surprised. I’m not. 

This is what Washington does. It protects its own and comes after anyone who threatens to expose them.
